title: Jeremiah
attributionNote: Traditional attributions are recorded as tradition, not as settled modern authorship. The book is a composite edited text.
description: Warnings of Jerusalem’s destruction and demands for repentance, largely rejected by the people, some of whom torture and persecute him. The complete Hebrew text and JPS 1917 translation are included in this imported edition.
historicalContext: Part of the Prophets division of the Tanakh. Its composition, editing and dating are debated; the catalogue records the text without claiming a single uncontested origin.
